name: Ouachita Parish, LA
findings: Ouachita Parish has 569 nonprofit organizations. 194 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 154 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Ouachita Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 11 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do hobby and sports organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 58 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
